# Claude Desktop Themes scene sources

These wallpapers are from [0toshigami/claude-desktop-themes](https://github.com/0toshigami/claude-desktop-themes/tree/1ac84ea764028dd1be6f8bc808ca18b622bcad2a), at commit `1ac84ea764028dd1be6f8bc808ca18b622bcad2a`, under the MIT license in this directory. The scene files are copied from `extension/src/scenes`. The scene kit collects the color and scene primitives from `extension/src/core.js`. The sky colors in the terminal renderer are adapted from `hooks/themes.ts`.

The CLI compiles these sources into its own JavaScriptCore renderer.
